sections.title: Introduction to Creative Writing: Fiction and Journalism
sections.description: An introduction to writing fiction and journalistic writing. We will focus on the main tools of fiction, such as characterization, dialogue, and description, as well as the forms of journalistic writing, including reporting, interviewing, editing, and commentary. Suitable for beginners or more experienced writers who want to return to fundamentals. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
